title: Colophon expressions documented in the supplied chapter
sourceLabel: Voice, Identity, and Self-representation: a Colophon Analysis
scope: Formula families, typological constructions, short markers, and explicitly discussed attested expressions; repeated spellings and quoted expansions are grouped. Not every quotation is treated as a recurrent formula.
attributionRule: Attribution records the association made by the chapter, not proof of first identification. Unknown Hands is not silently substituted for a named scholar.
websiteStatus: Awaiting review; not connected to the website.
